correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed nine affine points and nine retained lines with 27 incidence edges; BFS yields diameter 4 and exactly six three-vertex classes of mutual distance four, no cross-class distance-four pairs. Thus the inclusive radius-3 Rips complex is literally the join of six discrete 3-point sets: 4^6−1=4,095 faces, free H̃5 rank 2^6=64, no other reduced homology. Exhaustively found all 216 graph distance automorphisms (distinct backtrack traversal had 3,007 search nodes, compared with source 3,313; both yield exactly 216); verified signed block-cycle trace formula and histogram {-8:18,-2:36,0:54,1:56,4:42,16:9,64:1}. Full-group and point-line-preserving trace averages give fixed ranks 1 and 3. Independent integral orbit sum of the pure tensor is divisible by 12 and after dividing has 42 nonzero ±1 coordinates (21 each), hence primitive invariant and full rank-one fixed sublattice. Rational transfer after barycentric subdivision gives quotient reduced H5=Q.
